title: OldStone
description: OldStone is a nostalgic Minecraft modpack that recreates the feel of classic Minecraft while adding modern features, multiplayer support, and immersive enhancements for a fresh old-school experience.
body:
OldStone is a Minecraft modpack inspired by the classic era of Minecraft, designed to bring back the nostalgic feeling of old-school survival while combining it with the quality-of-life improvements and features of modern Minecraft.

The pack focuses on simple exploration, classic-style building, and the cozy atmosphere of older Minecraft versions, while still supporting modern gameplay systems and multiplayer.

Features
Classic-inspired textures, visuals, and atmosphere
Gameplay designed to feel closer to old Minecraft survival
Modern multiplayer support
New content and extra features that blend naturally with the classic style
Carefully selected mods to keep the experience simple, immersive, and fun
Improved world generation and exploration without losing the old-school feel

OldStone is made for players who miss the charm and simplicity of early Minecraft but still want the convenience and features of newer versions. Whether you're playing alone or with friends, the goal is to create a familiar but fresh Minecraft experience.
